verdict.rationale: Gusto's own docs describe an official hosted 'Embedded Dev Assistant' MCP server, with a remote URL config, that lets Cursor, Windsurf and Claude Desktop interact with the Embedded Payroll API and its documentation. It is labeled Beta and is scoped to Embedded Payroll developer assistance rather than general Gusto account operations. missing for 10: general-availability status, coverage beyond the Embedded Payroll dev-assistant scope (e.g. core Gusto account actions), documented tool list/auth details, independent hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The Embedded Dev Assistant Model Context Protocol (MCP) server enables AI-powered code editors like Cursor and Windsurf, as well as general-purpose tools like Claude Desktop, to interact directly with the Embedded Payroll API and relevant documentation.
Learn how to set up and test the Gusto Embedded Dev Assistant MCP server for AI-powered tools.
